brief.meaningEn: Come together at an arranged time, usually for a social activity.
brief.meaningZh: 按約定時間相聚，通常一起參與社交活動。
brief.grammar: meet up with someone; meet up for lunch; met up yesterday.
brief.register: Informal and friendly; more social than a formal meeting. A friend may ask another friend whether they want to meet up after class for a walk.
brief.boundaryZh: 須有相聚或約見的意思；在街上偶然遇見不等於事先相約。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把 meet up 當成必然開正式會議，也不要忽略相約的語境。
brief.outcomeZh: 能自然提出朋友間的約見安排。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 7, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: We meet up for lunch every Friday.

listening.en: The old classmates agreed to meet up at the park on Saturday and bring photos from school.
listening.zh: 舊同學約好星期六在公園見面，並帶來讀書時的照片。

options.en: Get together at an agreed place and time.
options.zh: 在約好的時間和地點相聚。

options.en: Hold a compulsory staff meeting at work.
options.zh: 在公司召開必須出席的員工會議。

options.en: Accidentally see one another on the street.
options.zh: 在街上偶然遇見對方。

options.en: Send photos without seeing anyone.
options.zh: 只寄照片，不與任何人見面。

listening.explanationZh: agreed、星期六和公園表明事先相約見面；不是偶遇或只寄照片。

reply.promptEn: How can we spend time together after exams?
reply.promptZh: （考試後，我們可以怎樣一起相聚？）

options.en: We could meet up for lunch next Saturday.
options.zh: 我們下星期六可以相約吃午飯。

options.en: Let us visit the new exhibition together.
options.zh: 我們一起參觀新展覽吧。

options.en: We could have a picnic when everyone is free.
options.zh: 大家有空時可以去野餐。

options.en: Why not choose a film and go as a group?
options.zh: 何不選一齣電影，一起去看？

reply.explanationZh: 四個建議都能讓朋友考試後相聚；金句以 meet up 明確提出相約見面。

scene.promptZh: 三位朋友透過訊息約定星期日下午在海濱散步。哪句最貼切？

options.en: They will meet up at the waterfront on Sunday.
options.zh: 他們星期日會在海濱相約見面。

options.en: They have already met by chance without arranging anything.
options.zh: 他們未經安排便已偶然遇見。

options.en: They will communicate only by message and never gather.
options.zh: 他們只會傳訊息，絕不相聚。

scene.explanationZh: 訊息裏已約定時間和地點，因此是相約見面；其餘兩句否定了約定和相聚。

contrast.promptZh: 按本課「事先相約相聚」的意思，哪種情況最不適合說 meet up？

options.en: Two cousins choose a café and agree to meet there tomorrow.
options.zh: 兩名表親選好咖啡店，約定明天在那裏見面。

options.en: Two strangers pass one another at a crossing and never speak.
options.zh: 兩名陌生人在過路處擦身而過，沒有交談。

options.en: Old friends arrange a walk together at six.
options.zh: 舊朋友約好六點一起散步。

contrast.explanationZh: 陌生人擦身而過並沒有相約或相聚；另外兩項有明確安排。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「大家下星期都有空，但還未決定去哪裏。」哪個回應最有幫助？

options.en: Let us meet up at the library café on Wednesday and decide where to go next.
options.zh: 我們星期三在圖書館咖啡店相約見面，再決定下一站去哪裏。

options.en: We cannot see one another unless the whole year is free.
options.zh: 除非全年都有空，否則我們不能見面。

options.en: Do not choose a time or place; everyone will somehow arrive together.
options.zh: 不用選時間或地點，大家自然會同時到達。

dialogue.explanationZh: 提出具體時間和地點，讓相聚可成事；其餘兩句沒有可行的安排。

speaking.en: We met up after the volunteer shift and shared stories over tea.
speaking.zh: 義工時段結束後，我們相約見面，一邊喝茶一邊分享故事。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明義工活動後發生了甚麼事。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你和兩位朋友很久沒有見面，今個星期日都有空。用一至兩句英文提出一項具體的相聚安排，包括地點或活動。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出朋友之間的相約見面，並提出實際的時間、地點或活動；不要寫成偶遇。

examples.en: Let us meet up at the riverside café on Sunday afternoon and catch up over tea.
examples.zh: 星期日下午，我們在河邊咖啡店相約見面，一邊喝茶一邊聊近況吧。

examples.en: We could meet up before the film and have an early dinner near the cinema.
examples.zh: 我們可以在電影開始前相約見面，到戲院附近早點吃晚飯。

takeaways.en: Our neighbours meet up for a walk once a month.
takeaways.zh: 我們的鄰居每個月相約散步一次。

takeaways.en: I met up with my cousin near the ferry pier.
takeaways.zh: 我在渡輪碼頭附近與表親相約見面。

notes: AI-authored first pass; independent editorial and release checks have not occurred.

brief.meaningEn: Browse shop displays or products for pleasure without intending to buy.
brief.meaningZh: 為了消遣而看商店陳列或商品，並不打算購買。
brief.grammar: go window-shopping; spend an afternoon window-shopping.
brief.register: Everyday leisure expression; may include browsing inside stores. A sibling may tell another sibling that they went window-shopping together without planning to buy anything.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是看商品而沒有即時購買打算；稍後改變主意不使先前用法錯誤。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把它理解成只看真正的玻璃櫥窗，也不要說成已經大量購物。
brief.outcomeZh: 能區分消遣式瀏覽與計劃中的採購。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 7, row 8; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: We spent the afternoon window-shopping in the city centre.

listening.en: We had no money to spend, so we went window-shopping and compared the book displays for fun.
listening.zh: 我們沒有錢可花，便只看不買地逛書店，為了消遣而比較書籍陳列。
listening.promptZh: 說話者逛店時的主要打算是甚麼？

options.en: Browse products without planning to buy.
options.zh: 看商品，但不打算購買。

options.en: Purchase every book on display.
options.zh: 買下所有陳列的書。

options.en: Clean the shop windows for pay.
options.zh: 有薪酬地清潔店舖櫥窗。

options.en: Search only for an urgent required textbook.
options.zh: 只尋找急需購買的指定課本。

listening.explanationZh: 沒有錢可花、為消遣比較陳列，表明是看而不買；不是清潔櫥窗或大採購。

reply.promptEn: What could we do at the shopping arcade without spending money?
reply.promptZh: （不花錢的話，我們在商場可以做甚麼？）

options.en: We could look at the public art displays.
options.zh: 我們可以看看公共藝術展品。

options.en: We could go window-shopping and admire the new designs.
options.zh: 我們可以只看不買地逛店，欣賞新設計。

options.en: We could sit and talk in the open seating area.
options.zh: 我們可以在公共座位區坐下聊天。

options.en: We could explore the free photography exhibition.
options.zh: 我們可以參觀免費攝影展。

reply.explanationZh: 四項都可以不花錢在商場消遣；金句特別指逛店看貨而不打算買。

scene.promptZh: 朋友在商店街看了幾家鞋店的新款，拍下喜歡的款式，當天沒有購買打算。哪句最貼切？

options.en: She spent the afternoon window-shopping for shoes.
options.zh: 她下午只看不買地逛鞋店。

options.en: She bought several pairs of shoes immediately.
options.zh: 她立刻買了幾雙鞋。

options.en: She was repairing the shops’ display windows.
options.zh: 她在修理店舖的陳列櫥窗。

scene.explanationZh: 看款式且當天不打算買，符合 window-shopping；其餘兩句加入購買或修窗的不同活動。

contrast.promptZh: 按本課「看商品但當時不打算買」的意思，哪種情況最不適合說 window-shopping？

options.en: A student browses clothing displays for fun and leaves without buying.
options.zh: 學生為消遣看看服裝陳列，沒有購物便離開。

options.en: A parent enters a pharmacy to collect medicine already ordered and pays for it.
options.zh: 家長進藥房領取已訂藥物並付款。

options.en: Two friends look at furniture styles without choosing a purchase.
options.zh: 兩名朋友看看家具款式，沒有決定購買。

contrast.explanationZh: 領取已訂藥物並付款是實際採購，不是消遣式瀏覽；另外兩項以觀看為主。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說：「還有半小時，錢不夠買東西，但我想看看新出的文具。」哪個回應最自然？

options.en: We can go window-shopping in the stationery shops and buy nothing today.
options.zh: 我們可以去文具店只看不買地逛逛，今天不購物。

options.en: If you look at a pen, you must pay for it immediately.
options.zh: 只要看了一支筆，就必須立即付款。

options.en: Let us avoid the shops, even though you want to see the new items.
options.zh: 雖然你想看新品，我們也不要去商店。

dialogue.explanationZh: 只想看新品又沒有購買預算，適合輕鬆地只看不買；其餘兩句不合朋友的願望。

speaking.en: The sisters went window-shopping after lunch and took notes on styles they liked.
speaking.zh: 兩姊妹午飯後只看不買地逛店，記下喜歡的款式。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明兩姊妹午飯後做了甚麼。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你和同學週末要到新開的商店街，大家想看環保用品的設計，但當天不打算買。用一至兩句英文描述計劃。
writing.selfCheckZh: 說明看商品設計是消遣，當天沒有購買打算；不要寫成已購物。

examples.en: We plan to go window-shopping for eco-friendly products on Saturday. We can compare designs without buying anything.
examples.zh: 我們打算星期六只看不買地逛環保用品店。即使不購物，也可以比較設計。

examples.en: Window-shopping at the new arcade will let us explore reusable items while keeping our money for later.
examples.zh: 在新商店街只看不買，能讓我們看看可重用用品，同時把錢留待日後使用。

takeaways.en: We went window-shopping and left without a single bag.
takeaways.zh: 我們只看不買地逛店，離開時一袋東西也沒有。

takeaways.en: Window-shopping can be a pleasant way to discover new designs.
takeaways.zh: 只看不買地逛店可以是發掘新設計的愉快方式。

notes: AI-authored first pass; independent editorial and release checks have not occurred.

brief.meaningEn: Work naturally within an ordinary routine without being impractical.
brief.meaningZh: 能自然融入平日作息，實際上容易持續。
brief.grammar: fit into everyday life; fits into everyday life.
brief.register: Neutral useful collocation for habits, activities and plans. A counsellor may ask a student whether the proposed exercise routine can fit into everyday life.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是與現有作息相容，不表示完全不用付出時間或努力。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要只因活動很好，就假設它必然能在忙碌日程中持續。
brief.outcomeZh: 能判斷一項新習慣是否實際適合日常作息。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 7, row 9; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The exercise plan must fit into everyday life.

listening.en: A ten-minute walk after dinner fits into everyday life more easily than a two-hour workout on every school night.
listening.zh: 晚飯後散步十分鐘，比每個上課日晚上運動兩小時更容易融入日常生活。
listening.promptZh: 說話者為何較推崇短時間散步？

options.en: It is easier to keep within a normal routine.
options.zh: 它較容易配合平常作息，長期維持。

options.en: It requires no time at all.
options.zh: 它完全不需要時間。

options.en: It guarantees the same result as every longer workout.
options.zh: 它保證與任何較長的運動得到相同效果。

options.en: It can happen only during school holidays.
options.zh: 它只能在學校假期進行。

listening.explanationZh: 十分鐘散步較能配合上課日作息；這不表示完全不用時間或保證效果相同。

reply.promptEn: Why are you choosing the shorter reading plan?
reply.promptZh: （你為何選擇較短的閱讀計劃？）

options.en: I can do it during my daily commute.
options.zh: 我可以在每天乘車時完成。

options.en: It fits into everyday life without replacing family time.
options.zh: 它能融入日常生活，不必佔去與家人相處的時間。

options.en: I am more likely to keep a manageable habit.
options.zh: 可負擔的習慣，我較有機會維持。

options.en: I still have time for other commitments.
options.zh: 我仍有時間處理其他責任。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都合理說明選擇較短計劃的原因；金句指出它與現有作息相容。

scene.promptZh: 學生每日巴士車程二十分鐘，想養成讀書習慣。哪項計劃最能 fit into everyday life？

options.en: Reading for ten minutes on the bus each weekday would fit into everyday life.
options.zh: 每個上課日在巴士上讀十分鐘，便能融入日常生活。

options.en: Read for four hours every school night despite existing homework.
options.zh: 即使已有功課，每個上課日晚上仍讀四小時。

options.en: Read only if a whole month suddenly becomes free.
options.zh: 只有突然空出整個月才讀書。

scene.explanationZh: 每日車程已有固定時間，十分鐘閱讀較容易融入作息；其餘計劃過於沉重或不穩定。

contrast.promptZh: 以本課「實際融入平常作息」的意思，哪種情況最不適合用 fit into everyday life？

options.en: A person cooks one simple meal at home on a usual weekday.
options.zh: 一個人在平常上課日於家中煮一頓簡單飯菜。

options.en: A club proposes a three-hour session every night despite members’ jobs and classes.
options.zh: 社團建議每晚活動三小時，卻無視會員的工作和課堂。

options.en: A runner adds a short walk to an existing lunch break.
options.zh: 跑手在原有午休時段加上一小段步行。

contrast.explanationZh: 每晚三小時又無視既有責任，難以自然融入日常；另外兩項利用可管理的時間。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我想學畫畫，但每晚只有十五分鐘。」哪個建議最合適？

options.en: A brief sketch after dinner could fit into everyday life better than a long daily class.
options.zh: 晚飯後畫一幅簡短素描，比每天上長課更容易融入日常生活。

options.en: If you cannot study for three hours nightly, there is no point trying.
options.zh: 如果不能每晚學三小時，就不用嘗試。

options.en: Sign up for a class that clashes with every family commitment.
options.zh: 報讀一個與所有家庭責任撞期的課程。

dialogue.explanationZh: 利用已有的短時間練習，較可能持續；其餘建議忽視朋友的時間限制。

speaking.en: The short language lesson fits into everyday life because I can complete it on the train.
speaking.zh: 這節短語言課能融入日常生活，因為我可以在火車上完成。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明這節課為何容易持續。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你的家人想每天做些伸展運動，但晚飯後只剩十分鐘空閒。用一至兩句英文提出實際可行的安排。
writing.selfCheckZh: 提出能配合既有作息的短時間伸展安排，不要聲稱完全不用時間或一定有特定健康效果。

examples.en: A short stretching routine can fit into everyday life if we do it for ten minutes after dinner.
examples.zh: 如果我們晚飯後做十分鐘，一套簡短的伸展動作便能融入日常生活。

examples.en: We could choose three simple stretches that fit into everyday life instead of planning a long class each night.
examples.zh: 我們可以選三個能融入日常生活的簡單伸展動作，而非每晚安排一堂長課。

takeaways.en: A small daily habit is easier to fit into everyday life than a demanding new schedule.
takeaways.zh: 細小的每日習慣，比要求很高的新時間表更容易融入日常生活。

takeaways.en: The reading plan fitted into everyday life once we shortened each session.
takeaways.zh: 我們縮短每節閱讀時間後，計劃便融入了日常生活。

notes: AI-authored first pass; independent editorial and release checks have not occurred.

brief.meaningEn: Appealing qualities that are not obvious on a first look.
brief.meaningZh: 初看未必發現、細看才察覺的吸引之處。
brief.grammar: the hidden charms of a place; has hidden charms.
brief.register: Positive figurative description, often for places or experiences. A local guide may tell visitors about a neighbourhood's hidden charms beyond its best-known street.
brief.boundaryZh: 須有後來才發現的吸引力；不是秘密危險或刻意隱藏的金錢。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要只因地方不出名就斷言必有吸引力，需有具體發現。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出一個不顯眼地方令人喜愛的具體細節。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 7, row 11; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The small town has hidden charms beyond its main street.

listening.en: The lane looked plain from the main road, but its tiny bookshops and painted doorways revealed hidden charms.
listening.zh: 從大路看，那條小巷很平凡，但小書店和彩繪門口展現了不易察覺的吸引之處。
listening.promptZh: 說話者後來發現小巷有甚麼特點？

options.en: It has attractive details that were not obvious at first.
options.zh: 它有初看不明顯的吸引之處。

options.en: It contains dangerous traps behind the doors.
options.zh: 門後藏着危險陷阱。

options.en: It has no shops or decorations at all.
options.zh: 那裏完全沒有店舖或裝飾。

options.en: It is famous only because of a large road sign.
options.zh: 它只因一個巨型路牌而出名。

listening.explanationZh: 初看平凡的小巷有小書店和彩繪門口，構成後來才發現的吸引之處。

reply.promptEn: Why did you enjoy visiting the small village twice?
reply.promptZh: （你為何喜歡兩次到那個小村莊遊覽？）

options.en: Its quiet paths gave me time to explore.
options.zh: 寧靜的小徑讓我有時間探索。

options.en: I liked talking to the local craftspeople.
options.zh: 我喜歡與當地工藝師聊天。

options.en: I noticed its hidden charms on my second visit.
options.zh: 第二次到訪時，我留意到村莊不易察覺的吸引之處。

options.en: The riverside walk was especially pleasant.
options.zh: 河邊的步道特別舒服。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都能合理解釋喜歡再次到訪；金句強調第二次才發現的吸引之處。

scene.promptZh: 社區公園入口很普通，走進去卻有漂亮壁畫和一個安靜的小花園。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The park has hidden charms beyond its plain entrance.
options.zh: 公園平凡的入口後面，藏着不易察覺的吸引之處。

options.en: The entrance proves there is nothing pleasant inside.
options.zh: 入口證明園內沒有任何宜人之處。

options.en: The park is attractive only because its entrance is grand.
options.zh: 公園吸引人只因入口宏偉。

scene.explanationZh: 入口普通，但園內有壁畫和小花園，正好顯示初看不明顯的吸引力。

contrast.promptZh: 以本課「初看不明顯的吸引力」的意思，哪個情況最不適合說 hidden charms？

options.en: A plain-looking café has a beautiful courtyard behind it.
options.zh: 外觀平凡的咖啡店後面有漂亮庭院。

options.en: A crowded venue is openly advertised for its huge illuminated sign and nothing else.
options.zh: 一個擠迫場地只以顯眼的巨型燈牌作宣傳，沒有其他吸引之處。

options.en: A small town reveals interesting craft stalls off the main street.
options.zh: 小鎮大街旁的小路有有趣的手工藝攤位。

contrast.explanationZh: 場地只有一個一眼可見的燈牌，沒有後來才發現的吸引之處；其餘兩項有不顯眼的特色。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「這條舊街看起來沒甚麼特別，還值得走進去嗎？」你已知道裏面有特色小店。哪個回應最合宜？

options.en: Yes, it has hidden charms, such as the tiny music shop around the corner.
options.zh: 值得，那裏有不易察覺的吸引之處，例如轉角的小音樂店。

options.en: There is nothing to see, even though I found several unique shops.
options.zh: 沒有甚麼可看，雖然我發現了幾間特色小店。

options.en: Every old street is guaranteed to be amazing.
options.zh: 每條舊街都保證精彩。

dialogue.explanationZh: 具體指出轉角的小店，能解釋為何值得探索；其他回應自相矛盾或誇大。

speaking.en: The old market revealed its hidden charms when we found a quiet courtyard behind the stalls.
speaking.zh: 我們在攤位後發現寧靜庭院時，才察覺舊市場不易察覺的吸引之處。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明為何舊市場值得探索。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你帶朋友參觀一所外觀普通的社區圖書館，裏面卻有一面漂亮的手繪地圖和舒適的閱讀角。用一至兩句英文說明它值得參觀的原因。
writing.selfCheckZh: 先指出外觀普通，再具體說明入內才發現的吸引之處；不要只稱讚它「很好」。

examples.en: The library has hidden charms behind its plain front door: a hand-painted map and a cosy reading corner.
examples.zh: 圖書館外門平凡，裏面卻有不易察覺的吸引之處：手繪地圖和舒適的閱讀角。

examples.en: Its hidden charms become clear once you enter and see the colourful map beside the quiet seats.
examples.zh: 走進去看到安靜座位旁的彩色地圖後，你便會發現它不易察覺的吸引之處。

takeaways.en: The modest café has hidden charms in its little garden.
takeaways.zh: 那間不起眼的咖啡店，小花園裏有不易察覺的吸引之處。

takeaways.en: A second visit helped me notice the neighbourhood’s hidden charms.
takeaways.zh: 第二次到訪令我留意到社區不易察覺的吸引之處。

brief.meaningEn: Divide broadly into two groups of opinions or preferences.
brief.meaningZh: 按意見或喜好，大致分成兩個主要群體。
brief.grammar: fall into two main camps; fell into two main camps.
brief.register: Neutral discussion phrase; the groups need not be hostile. A discussion leader may tell participants that responses fall into two main camps before comparing them.
brief.boundaryZh: 表示兩個主要類別，仍可能有少數其他看法；不應憑一兩人就概括所有人。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要理解成真的住進兩個營地，或必然有敵對陣營。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用概括語氣描述兩組主要不同看法。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 7, row 15; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The survey responses fall into two main camps.

listening.en: In our survey, answers fell into two main camps: some wanted a quiet reading room, while others preferred group tables.
listening.zh: 在我們的調查中，答案主要分成兩派：有些人想要安靜閱讀室，另一些人較喜歡小組桌子。
listening.promptZh: 調查答案呈現甚麼分布？

options.en: There were two broad groups of preferences.
options.zh: 受訪者大致有兩類不同喜好。

options.en: Everyone gave exactly the same answer.
options.zh: 所有人給出完全相同的答案。

options.en: Students discussed furniture colours but expressed no preference about room layout.
options.zh: 學生討論了家具顏色，卻沒有表達對房間佈局的喜好。

options.en: The survey asked only one person.
options.zh: 調查只問了一個人。

listening.explanationZh: 想要安靜閱讀與偏好小組桌子，形成兩個主要喜好群體。

reply.promptEn: How did students respond to the proposed lunch changes?
reply.promptZh: （學生怎樣看待午餐安排的改動建議？）

options.en: Some liked the earlier break.
options.zh: 有些人喜歡較早的午休。

options.en: Others wanted the present timetable.
options.zh: 另一些人想保留現有時間表。

options.en: Students fell into two main camps over the proposal.
options.zh: 學生對這項建議的意見主要分成兩派。

options.en: A few asked for a chance to discuss it first.
options.zh: 少數人要求先有機會討論。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都可合理描述學生的反應；金句概括兩個主要意見群體，不排除少數其他意見。

scene.promptZh: 學生會調查顯示，多數人支持延長圖書館開放時間，另一大群人希望維持原狀，只有少數人提出第三方案。哪句最貼切？

options.en: Responses fall into two main camps, with a few other suggestions.
options.zh: 回應主要分成兩派，另有少數其他建議。

options.en: Every student supports one identical option.
options.zh: 每名學生都支持同一選項。

options.en: No clear preference groups emerged; every response was unrelated to the others.
options.zh: 沒有形成明顯的意見群組；每個回應都與其他回應毫無關係。

scene.explanationZh: 兩大群人意見不同，同時有少數第三方案，故可概括為兩派而不抹去少數聲音。

contrast.promptZh: 按本課「兩個主要意見群體」的意思，哪種情況最不適合說 fall into two main camps？

options.en: A debate group is roughly split between two policy choices.
options.zh: 辯論小組大致分成支持兩項政策的兩群。

options.en: Everyone in a small team agrees on the same plan.
options.zh: 一個小團隊所有人都同意同一計劃。

options.en: A poll has two large preference groups and a few undecided people.
options.zh: 民調有兩大喜好群體，也有少數未決定的人。

contrast.explanationZh: 全隊意見一致，便沒有兩個主要群體；另外兩項可以用概括性的「兩派」。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友問：「為何大家對新球場的安排一直有不同意見？」你看過民調：受訪者主要分成兩組，一組希望增加球場，另一組希望增加座位。哪個回應最準確？

options.en: The responses fall into two main camps: some want more courts, while others prefer more seating.
options.zh: 回應主要分成兩派：有些人想要更多球場，另一些人希望有更多座位。

options.en: Every respondent wants more seating and no additional courts.
options.zh: 每名受訪者都想要更多座位，不想增加球場。

options.en: One person’s opinion tells us what every respondent thinks.
options.zh: 一個人的意見足以代表所有受訪者。

dialogue.explanationZh: 民調能支持兩大偏好群體的概括；其他選項錯誤地說全體意見一致或以個別意見代表全體。

speaking.en: At the planning meeting, opinions fell into two main camps over where to build the playground.
speaking.zh: 在規劃會議上，關於遊樂場應建在哪裏，意見主要分成兩派。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明規劃會議的意見如何分布。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你們班調查下次旅行地點。二十人想去博物館，十八人想去海灘，另有兩人提出其他地點。用一至兩句英文概括調查結果。
writing.selfCheckZh: 描述兩個主要喜好群體，同時可以提到少數其他建議；不要說全班只有兩種看法。

examples.en: The class fell into two main camps: twenty preferred the museum and eighteen chose the beach. Two suggested other places.
examples.zh: 全班意見主要分成兩派：二十人較喜歡博物館，十八人選海灘。另有兩人提出其他地點。

examples.en: The responses to our survey fall into two main camps, with the museum and the beach drawing most votes. A few classmates preferred elsewhere.
examples.zh: 我們的調查回應主要分成兩派，博物館和海灘得到最多票。少數同學喜歡其他地點。

takeaways.en: The views fall into two main camps, though a few people remain undecided.
takeaways.zh: 意見主要分成兩派，雖然少數人仍未決定。

takeaways.en: The committee fell into two main camps on the timetable question.
takeaways.zh: 委員會對時間表問題的意見主要分成兩派。
